meta.description: Splice screenshots in the browser. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

empty.title: Drop screenshots here
empty.subtitle: Or click the button below to choose images or a zip. Everything runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

steps.drag: Drag the handles to select subtitle area

overlay.title: Release to import
overlay.hint: Drop images, folders, or a zip

empty.title: Live preview
empty.hint: Add screenshots and the result appears here instantly.

screenshot.useLocalRatioHint: Switched to local ratio for this screenshot only

resize.hint: Drag to resize, double-click to reset the layout

paragraphs.handles: Drag a horizontal handle on a screenshot to adjust the crop used in the spliced image.
paragraphs.double: Double-click a horizontal handle to switch between local crop and global crop. Alt (⌥)-drag also enters local crop.
paragraphs.splitter: On wide layouts, drag the center splitter to resize both panels. Double-click it to reset the layout.
paragraphs.persist: Screenshots are saved in this browser and survive refresh until you clear them or wipe site data.
paragraphs.drop: Drop images, folders, or a zip anywhere on the window, or paste an image from the clipboard.
